tldr: Lilith in Virgo: the wound of never good enough; anxiety spirals and work as worth.
body: With Lilith in Virgo, one bad moment spirals into expecting everything to go wrong. Insecurity gets managed through work and service: harder, longer, more precise, because being productive is the only thing that quiets the feeling of not being enough.
gift: Extraordinary work ethic, precision, and genuine usefulness to others.
challenge: Pessimistic spirals that strain relationships, work addiction to the point of exhaustion, criticism turned on self and everyone else.
note: Distilled from the Black Moon Lilith compilation (Resources/937057437-Lillith-Black-Moon.docx), 'Black Moon Lilith in the Signs' long-form chapter. Lilith reads as a wound-point: shame and rejection processed through the sign's style. Owner-reviewed for live use, 2026-07-28.
